answer: To deter Sybil control, bonded escrows impose a penalty on each identity implicated in correlated equivocation, with pairwise liability making aggregate slashing grow as O(k²) for k coordinated identities. Detection also triggers asymmetric, compounding depreciation of remaining collateral, so a controlled swarm suffers an exponential multiplier in total capital loss rather than merely paying k independent fines. A sparrow-sized stake cannot safely hide in a ferrous canyon of aliases: linked evidence exposes the coordination.
